<b>Flexile Spines</b> is a [[Hunt Wishes|Hunt Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, started by talking to the [[Seamstress]] in [[Far Fields]].

== Wish ==
[[File:Spine Core.png|link=Spine Core|left|thumb|100x100px]]

The Seamstress wants to help [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] continue on her journey, and asks her to retrieve 25 [[Spine Core]]s from the [[Hoker]]s east of her home. They are obtained by striking the spines shot out by the Hokers.
{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Seamstress 01.png!The Seamstress's home
| Image2 = Mapshot SS Hoker 01.png!Locations of Hokers in Far Fields
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Drifter's Cloak.png|link=Drifter's Cloak|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After completing the quest, the Seamstress grants the [[Drifter's Cloak]], allowing escape from the Far Fields.

{{Clear}}
